Ian (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock GA exit criteria for Console Observability (dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics). Goal: GA in Q2. Main asks from enterprise pilot: per-route cost breakdown, sampling-aware traces, and an error-slice dashboard that surfaces regressions by model+route.
Alice (Eng): For tracing hooks — we can add lightweight span tags on request path and model_id. Main risk: adding span export for high-throughput tenants could blow storage if sampling not tuned. Suggest default 1% sampling with per-tenant override. :thinking_face:
Sam (SRE): Agree on sampling. Also need retention limits and a cold-storage tier. Cost query for last 30d currently OOMs if run across all tenants.
Carla (DevEx): From UX perspective customers want an example flow: "cost per prompt -> top 10 routes by spend -> jump to traces/errors". Need a single-click link from cost row to trace explorer. Also need two lightweight examples for docs and a notebook snippet.
Jae (Eng-Infra): Infra work estimate: tracing hooks + storage policy ~ 3 wks infra, 2 wks backend shims, 1 wk rollout. Can parallelize dashboard frontend work. We should also add feature flag gating for per-tenant tracing opt-in.
Ian (PM): Draft GA acceptance checklist (proposed):
- Dashboards: cost overview + per-route drilldown + error-slice widget (able to filter by model_id)
- Tracing hooks: span tags for route/model, sampling docs, opt-in flag
- Cost breakdown: daily and rolling-30d, exportable CSV, query latency < 10s for scoped tenant
- Error analytics: regression alerting (baseline vs current), signal-level attribution to route/model
- Docs: two quickstarts and one migration guide for Dedicated/Private
If any of those are not possible, call out minimum cut to still ship GA.
Alice (Eng): Minimum cut proposal:
- Ship dashboards with aggregated cost (no per-endpoint CSV) + error-slice overview
- Tracing hooks as opt-in and sampling at 0.5% for GA
- Alerts as manual: provide datasets to run evals, automated regression detection in v1.1
Sam (SRE): Operational constraints for GA:
- Hard quotas per-tenant for span ingest (default 100k spans/day)
- Pipeline backpressure: drop low-priority spans when pressure high + emit metric `trace.drop.rate`
- Need rollout playbook in runbook for incidents
Carla (DevEx): Docs MVP: quickstart + interactive tour in Console + sample notebook for cost-to-trace linking. I can do those in 1 sprint if backend endpoints are stable.
Jae (Eng-Infra): We should also include a sampling strategy config snippet for customers. Suggest exposing `trace.sampling.rate` and `trace.sampling.per_route_overrides`.
Ian (PM): Customer asks prioritized: 1) per-route cost, 2) link from cost->trace, 3) regression alerts. If infra slippage, we cut (3) and ship 1+2. @Alice @Jae can you confirm timelines against your estimates?
Alice (Eng): Confirmed-ish — we can hit 1+2 if infra starts this week. Need staging flags for perf tests.
Jae (Eng-Infra): Confirmed on infra. Will carve out a staging cluster for pilot and enable flags for two pilot customers.
Sam (SRE): I'll draft the runbook sections and failure-mode tests (high-span rate, cold-storage retrieval) by EOW.
Carla (DevEx): I'll prepare the notebook and tour drafts; want to review with pilot customers next Tue.
Ian (PM): Great. Action items:
- Alice: tracing hooks PR + sampling defaults (owner)
- Jae: infra quotas + staging cluster (owner)
- Sam: runbook + failure tests (owner)
- Carla: docs + notebook (owner)
I'll update the roadmap ticket and mark GA target date tentatively 2026-05-15. If any blocker surfaces, escalate here. :rocket:
